title: From Fear to Freedom: A Family's Natural Cancer Recovery at Hippocrates

content:

Hosts Brian and Anna Maria Clement welcome guests Marissa and Adam, who share how Hippocrates programs and lifestyle changes helped Marissa's mother reverse advanced breast cancer and helped Adam achieve remission from lymphoma.

The episode highlights sprouting, plant‑based nutrition, movement, and mind‑body practices as keys to healing and offers inspiration for those seeking alternative approaches to chronic disease.

For more information or to schedule a tour, visit HippocratesHealthInstitute.org or call 561-471-8876.
